checks.name: gate-hierarchy
checks.expectation: Focused gates should subordinate their decisions to one aggregate release source of truth.
checks.summary: The release gate hierarchy is explicit in docs and in the aggregate gate script.

checks.name: reproducibility
checks.expectation: Local and CI evidence should be reproducible through pinned toolchains, wrappers, and policy files.
checks.summary: Key reproducibility assets are present across frontend and Gradle-based projects.

checks.name: evidence-provenance
checks.expectation: Readiness evidence should be attributable to commits, environments, and run metadata.
checks.summary: Release provenance hooks exist and current aggregate evidence is readable.

checks.name: release-decision-discipline
checks.expectation: Release decisions should be made against explicit blocker roadmaps, scope rules, and policy documents.
checks.summary: Roadmap, scope, and release policy assets are all present.

checks.name: recovery-and-rollback-readiness
checks.expectation: Release discipline should include recovery, rollback, and external audit export readiness.
checks.summary: Rollback and audit-export surfaces are represented in UI, runtime, and tests.

checks.name: decision-memory
checks.expectation: Important engineering and release decisions should leave durable written memory, ideally including ADR-style records.
checks.summary: Release docs are present, but ADR-style decision memory is missing or empty.
